blocks.title: Explain the important decision
blocks.text: Sequence changes score before selection tests it. The condition is true at exactly 10 because >= includes the boundary.

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the order of execution
blocks.text: int score = 7; score = score + 3; if (score >= 10) Console.WriteLine("Pass");

blocks.title: Worked example · Update in sequence
blocks.text: score starts at 7. Adding 3 changes the same variable to 10; the condition has not been tested yet.

blocks.title: Worked example · Evaluate the condition
blocks.text: Substitute the new value: 10 >= 10 is true. Using the old value 7 would trace the wrong state.
